summary: Reading is a solid base: meaning, structure and inference questions are mostly right. Points are leaking in two places: punctuation rules in Writing, and anything non-linear in Math (quadratics, exponentials, equivalent forms). Both are rule-based and quick to fix, which is why the target is realistic for December.

fix_notes.SEC.BND: Five of seven missed. Learn the four sentence-joining rules (period, semicolon, colon, comma + and/but) and drill 15 items a day for two weeks.
fix_notes.ADV.2: Set up correctly but lost on solving. Factor, the quadratic formula, and when to let Desmos find the intersection instead.
fix_notes.ADV.3: Reads graphs well; struggles with exponential growth written as a function. Two lessons on forms and what each number means.
